HIS-03.note: Which is NOT literature of the Vedic tradition -> Puranas. Chapter teaches the Vedic corpus as the four Vedas plus the later Vedic texts (Upanishads); NCERT XII Theme 2 treats Puranic literature as later literature. The Puranas are not part of the corpus taught, so the 'not' answer is derivable from the chapter.

Exact hymn count of the Rigveda (official answer 1028). NCERT Class VI (fess104) says only 'more than a thousand hymns'; the exact figure 1028 does not appear in any fetched NCERT/WBBSE page usable as a chapter source, so the exact count is not taught. An exam_note in section vedic_literature discloses this to students.

'Tamaso Ma Jyotirgamaya' -> Brihadaranyaka Upanishad.
